title: 9 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Depression
intro: Herbal essential oils for depression are naturally derived plant extracts used to promote mental well-being and alleviate symptoms of depression. They offer numerous benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving mood, and enhancing sleep quality. Some of the most effective herbal essential oils for depression include bergamot, lavender, ylang-ylang, chamomile, frankincense, and geranium, which have been shown to reduce anxiety and stress levels, promote relaxation, and uplift mood. By incorporating these oils into aromatherapy practices, such as inhaling them through steam inhalation or using them in diffusion, individuals can experience a reduction in symptoms of depression and an improvement in overall mental health.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia essential oils have been traditionally used to treat depression due to their calming and mood-enhancing properties. The anxiolytic and sedative effects of this herbal preparation help to alleviate symptoms of depression by reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Lavandula angustifolia essential oils, including linalool and linalyl acetate, contribute to its antidepressant effects by modulating neurotransmitter activity and regulating the body's stress response. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia essential oils to treat depression include improved mood, reduced anxiety, and enhanced sleep quality, making it a popular natural remedy for individuals seeking alternative treatments for this ailment.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)", Lavandula angustifolia essential oils exhibit antidepressant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of depression.

preparations.preparation_desc: Melissa officinalis essential oils, also known as lemon balm, have been traditionally used to treat depression due to its anxiolytic and antidepressant properties. The herbal preparation helps to treat depression by promoting relaxation, reducing stress and anxiety, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Melissa officinalis essential oils, including rosmarinic acid, luteolin, and melissic acid, have been shown to inhibit the activity of enzymes involved in the production of neurotransmitters, thereby helping to regulate mood. The benefits of using Melissa officinalis essential oils to treat depression include reduced symptoms of anxiety and depression, improved sleep quality, and enhanced mood, making it a natural and effective remedy for this common ailment.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "BMC complementary medicine and therapies", Melissa officinalis essential oils may be beneficial for depression as a study found that patients with type 2 diabetes and depressive symptoms who received a 700 mg/day hydroalcoholic extract of Melissa officinalis for 12 weeks showed a significant decrease in depression severity compared to baseline.

preparations.preparation_desc: Valeriana officinalis essential oils have been traditionally used to treat depression due to their sedative, anxiolytic, and antidepressant properties. By regulating the body's GABA and serotonin levels, Valeriana officinalis essential oils help to balance mood and reduce feelings of sadness and hopelessness associated with depression. The benefits of using Valeriana officinalis essential oils to treat depression include reduced symptoms of anxiety, improved sleep quality, and enhanced mood stability, making it a natural and holistic approach to managing this complex condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Chemical & pharmaceutical bulletin", Valeriana officinalis essential oils may have antidepressant properties as they significantly inhibited immobility induced by a forced swimming test in rats.

The benefits of using Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils to treat depression include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality, ultimately contributing to a sense of well-being. preparations.preparation_study: According to "Biomedicine & pharmacotherapy = Biomedecine & pharmacotherapie", Rosmarinus officinalis essential oils, although not specifically mentioned, its phytochemical compounds, including flavanoids, can exhibit anti-depressant activity, however, a detailed investigation of its effects is still needed.

preparations.preparation_desc: Ginkgo biloba essential oils have been traditionally used to help alleviate symptoms of depression due to its adaptogenic and neuroprotective properties. Regular use of Ginkgo biloba essential oils has been associated with several benefits, including improved cognitive function, enhanced mood, and reduced symptoms of anxiety and depression.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Life sciences", Ginkgo biloba essential oils for depression may be effective due to their ability to produce reversible inhibition of rat brain monoamine (MAO), which may be a mechanism underlying its reported anti-stress and anxiolytic activities.

This herbal preparation helps to treat depression by modulating the activity of neurotransmitters, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation, ultimately leading to improved mood and reduced symptoms.
